scientific_integrity: The four-letter count has a proof by a finite recurrence and a separate complete enumeration of 369600 words. The five-letter count is evaluated by the exact recurrence, with no independent exhaustive brute check. No independent scientific review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The alphabet-size recurrence is exact, but no closed form or asymptotics for the enumeration are proved; values supplied through q=5 only. Finite counts do not demonstrate experimental robustness in DNA data storage.
title: Palindromic three-subsequence covers: exact DNA-alphabet census and a general pairwise criterion
